details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:359-396 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `review_final_ci_sweep_main`, the cap check and increment (`[ "${checked}" -lt "${max}" ] || continue` / `checked=$((checked + 1))`, lines 366-367) run before the priority-lane deferral check (lines 378-384), so every head the hold defers still uses up a FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK slot.
  WHY: When `max` or more deferred heads come first, a later head past PRIORITY_LANE_MAX_DEFER_MINUTES (`outcome=released reason=max_defer`) is never reached, which breaks the "No PR is held back for longer than a cap" guarantee for as long as the hold lasts. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Reviewers disagree on the base-sync loop: minimax_minimax-m3 says `base_sync_checked` is also incremented before the deferral check at 443-447, while z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says that loop increments only after a productive call at line 449.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3748-3779 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_priority_lane_decide` measures the starvation cap from the PR's REST `updated_at`, not from the first skip as the issue requires.
  WHY: A PR whose `updated_at` is already older than the cap is released on the first held tick, so the hold never applies to it, and any later activity resets the clock, so a PR can be held past the cap. All flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR; minimax_minimax-m3 dismissed it because the issue allows "last pipeline activity".
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:230-647 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_mt_pr_is_priority` (lines 630-646, called ungated at 460/480) uses `MT_PRIORITY_LABELS_RAW`/`MT_PRIORITY_LABELS_JSON` (line 233), whose default now includes `ai:priority`, and never checks `_pr_priority_lane_enabled`; only the lease-grant path (`_mt_priority_lane_on`, 1804-1809) is gated.
  WHY: With PRIORITY_LANE_ENABLED=false, a PR linked to an `ai:priority` issue still bypasses older verified non-priority blockers, so the documented rollback is incomplete. Severity is disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated NIT, the others MAJOR, and minimax_minimax-m3 called it a design choice.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3686-3740 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The priority pressure detector maps a queued security-audit run to a PR only by its title `Security Audit (PR #N)` and never checks the run's target `ref`/head SHA, although `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml` accepts `pr_number` and `ref` separately.
  WHY: A queued audit titled for a priority PR but auditing a different ref, or the default branch, can turn on the hold and defer non-priority work for up to the cap. Severity is disputed: gemini and luna rated MAJOR, glm NIT (impact is bounded by fail-open and the cap); sonnet and minimax dismissed it.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:382-452 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `fci_lane_deferred` is incremented in the ensure loop (line 382) and the base-sync loop (line 445) and never reset between them, so the `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC ... deferred_priority_lane=` summary (line 452) reports a total for both passes.
  WHY: Ensure-pass deferrals are counted twice by any consumer that adds up both summary lines (397 and 452), and neither line gives a correct per-pass count. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:438-452 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `base_sync_queue` is filled from `failed_candidates` and the ensure-loop pushes, sorted by failure timestamp only (`sort -k4,4`, line 450), and processed under `base_sync_checked < max` without priority ordering.
  WHY: A priority PR that needs a base sync can be starved behind non-priority failed-CI PRs in the same tick, which breaks "dispatch priority PRs before any other PR in the same tick".
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3633-3642 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `$((10#...))` bounds arithmetic in `_pr_priority_lane_settings` for PRIORITY_LANE_WAIT_MINUTES sits in the same compound conditional as the regex check. gemini says it runs before validation; minimax says the pattern is fragile and the warning text does not match what is validated.
  WHY: A non-numeric value can produce a bash arithmetic error diagnostic (gemini), or would do so if the check were ever hoisted (minimax). Both rated NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dismissed it because `||` short-circuits.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3694-3702 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The wedge-cutoff fallback in `review_sweep_priority_lane_hold` (scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh lines 273-278) uses `_merge_lease_wedged_queued_seconds`, which turns `ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS=0` into the 24-hour default.
  WHY: The reaper treats `=0` as disabled but the priority-lane wedge filter does not, so runs older than 24h are still treated as wedged.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:159-170 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:priority` label is created in a subshell (`source .../label_helpers.sh && ensure_label_exists "ai:priority"`, output suppressed), so `_AI_LABEL_ENSURED_CACHE` is lost, and with no catalogue entry the label gets generic metadata.
  WHY: Later label creation in the same process makes an extra API call, and the label is created repo-wide with the fallback colour/description.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Create the `ai:priority` label where the pipeline creates its other labels." (Approach step 5 / Implementation step 5; "No operator step")
  expected_change_site: scripts/label_helpers.sh `_AI_LABEL_COLORS` / `_AI_LABEL_DESCS` (next to `ai:merge-lease-wait` at lines 72/142 and `ai:workflow-heal` at lines 81/151); also .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json per z-ai_glm-5_3-flash
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR has no hunk in scripts/label_helpers.sh (and, per glm, none in .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json; minimax says that file does not exist). The label is only created lazily via `ensure_label_exists "ai:priority"` in `review_sweep_annotate_head_gate` (scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:159-170), with the generic fallback colour `1d76db` and description "AI workflow label", and only in repos that run this review sweep with the lane on.
- requirement: "The review sweep and the final-CI sweep dispatch priority PRs before any other PR in the same tick."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh base-sync dispatch pass (lines 438-450)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only the ensure-pass `candidates` list is priority-ordered (jq at lines 346-355). `base_sync_queue` (from `failed_candidates` at 410-426 plus ensure-loop pushes at line 394) is sorted only by failure time (`sort -k4,4`, line 450) and drained under `base_sync_checked < max`, so non-priority heads can use up the cap before a priority head is reached.
- requirement: "While at least one priority PR has a review, security-audit or final-CI run that has been queued for more than a threshold, the sweep and the lease tick do not start new review or final-CI dispatches for non-priority PRs."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh merge-train release loop, before `_mt_dispatch_review`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The release loop removes the queue label and dispatches review at lines 3059-3074 (`_mt_dispatch_review` at line 3074) without checking the priority hold. The hold is applied only in `_mt_merge_lease_tick` / `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 dismissed this gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:review_final_ci_sweep_main, lines 366-367 (`[ "${checked}" -lt "${max}" ] || continue` then `checked=$((checked + 1))`), which run before the priority-lane check at lines 380-384 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A deferred head still uses up a FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK slot, so a later head past PRIORITY_LANE_MAX_DEFER_MINUTES never reaches `_pr_priority_lane_decide`.
  WHY: While a hold lasts, a PR past the cap gets no final CI, which breaks "No PR is held back for longer than a cap". Fix: for `success` heads, run the deferral check before the cap check.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_priority_lane_decide (`pld_since` → `pld_since_epoch`, `[ $(( pld_now - pld_since_epoch )) -ge "${PRIORITY_LANE_MAX_DEFER_S}" ]`); callers .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh lines 381 and 444, scripts/review_merge_train.sh _mt_priority_lane_defer_for_base | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cap is measured from `updated_at`, not from the first skip.
  WHY: Stale PRs are released on the first held tick, and unrelated activity restarts the clock, so a PR can be held past the cap.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:line 233, `MT_PRIORITY_LABELS_RAW="${MERGE_TRAIN_PRIORITY_LABELS-ai:workflow-heal,ai:security,ai:priority}"`, used by _mt_pr_is_priority (lines 630-646, called at 460 and 480) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The blocker bypass and `_merge_lease_order_key` still treat `ai:priority` as priority when PRIORITY_LANE_ENABLED is off.
  WHY: The documented rollback is incomplete. Fix: document the exception, or drop `ai:priority` from MT_PRIORITY_LABELS_JSON when the lane is off.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:`fci_lane_deferred` incremented at line 382 and line 445, printed at line 452 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The BASE_SYNC summary reports the total of both passes.
  WHY: Log parsers count ensure-pass deferrals twice. Fix: reset the counter before line 438.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Create the `ai:priority` label where the pipeline creates its other labels." Also: "consumers get it at the next `@stable` release. No operator step."
  Expected change site: scripts/label_helpers.sh (`_AI_LABEL_COLORS` / `_AI_LABEL_DESCS`, next to `ai:merge-lease-wait` at lines 72/142 and `ai:workflow-heal` at lines 81/151)
  Evidence of absence: No hunk in scripts/label_helpers.sh. The label is only created lazily via `ensure_label_exists "ai:priority"` in review_sweep_annotate_head_gate, with the generic colour/description.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The review sweep and the final-CI sweep dispatch priority PRs before any other PR in the same tick."
  Expected change site: base-sync pass in scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh (lines 438-450)
  Evidence of absence: `base_sync_queue` is sorted only by failure time (`sort -k4,4`, line 450) under `base_sync_checked < max`.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: run the deferral check before the cap check (lines 366-384, about 6 lines); add `fci_lane_deferred=0` before line 438 (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- NOTE (dismissed, not findings): `_pr_priority_lane_settings` arithmetic error (`||` short-circuits); security-audit title as pressure evidence (needs write access, bounded by the cap); rel
